confidence: Low: nearly everyone now has a grievance and unrelated misconduct; mechanism still underdetermined.
plausibility_notes: Artie's alternative employment meaningfully weakens apparent primary motive.
Warning and blackout have confessed nonmurder explanations, but neither confession alone excludes poison.
Thirty polished admissions follow almost the same wrongdoing-plus-Grant-pressure-plus-self-rebuke pattern; ordinary guests may struggle to distinguish voices.
Some admissions resolve earlier documents fairly, while repeated new scandals inflate the suspect field.
